description: This file contains implementation of JSON serialization functions and helper methods for scheduler metrics in a 3GPP-related telecommunications project, including conversion of internal data structures to JSON format.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_event
classes.description: Represents a scheduler cell event with different event types such as ue_add, ue_reconf, ue_rem.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_metrics
classes.description: Holds metrics related to a user equipment (UE) in the scheduler, including signal quality, data rates, and delay statistics.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics
classes.description: Contains metrics for a scheduler cell, including error counts, latency, and resource usage.

classes.name: scheduler_metrics_report
classes.description: Aggregates all scheduler metrics for reporting, including cell and UE metrics.

methods.name: event_to_string
methods.description: Converts scheduler cell event types to string representations.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes scheduler cell events, UE metrics, cell metrics, and the overall report to JSON.
